full_judgment:
Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury, J: This is a petition by defendant No. 2, Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) and Assistant Custodian, Vested Property, Bagerhat, for leave to appeal from the order of a Single Bench of the High Court Division, being Civil Order No. 5112 of 1997 dated 28 August 1997 summarily rejecting his revisional application against the concurrent judgment and decree of the two courts below in a suit for specific performance of a contract for sale. 

 4. The trial court rejected the plea of the defendant that the suit house was a vested property. It found the plaintiff version true and decreed the suit.
